Dana, the settled deadline for the signed Thornbury Cloth Co. order form is **19 November**. I've replied in your thread in #north-team.

Marcus first posted 21 December in #north-team on 14 October. Later that morning he corrected it to 19 November in #north-random, saying he'd read the wrong line. You're in that channel, so you can check his message yourself. I haven't seen anything since that changes it.

Two things are still out of date. The 21 December post is still up in #north-team with no correction under it. The brain also still holds the old 21 December note: I tried to mark it out of date but couldn't, because the brain couldn't find that note's id. So if the earlier date turns up anywhere, 19 November is the right one.
